title: Add fastReplaceValuesAsync and fastReplaceValues to RMultimap and its implementations.

timeline.body:
Is faster than replaceValues and replaceValuesAsync by not returning the new values.

Closes #6294.
Add these methods to RMultimapRx and RMultimapReactive interfaces as well
timeline.diff_hunk:
@@ -180,6 +180,19 @@ public interface RMultimap extends RExpirable, RMultimapAsync { */ Collection replaceValues(K key, Iterable values); + /** + * Stores a collection of values with the same key, replacing any existing + * values for that key. Is faster than {@link #replaceValues} by not returning + * by not returning the values. + * + *

If {@code values} is empty, this is equivalent to + * {@link #removeAll(Object) removeAll(key)}. + * + * @param key - map key + * @param values - map values + */ + void fastReplaceValues(K key, Iterable values);

timeline.body: A separate method is needed without returnValues parameter and "local members = redis.call('lrange', KEYS[2], 0, -1);" usage

reply.body: No longer doing `SMEMBERS` or `LRANGE` when `returnValues == false`. Kept the single method approach to try to avoid duplication, but let me know if you still prefer the two separate methods!
Yes, please make a separate method.

timeline.message:
Add fastReplaceValuesAsync and fastReplaceValues to RMultimap and its implementations.

Is faster than replaceValues and replaceValuesAsync by not returning the new values.

Signed-off-by: David Reis <david.alex.reis.97@gmail.com>
timeline.author: David Reis
